verdict.rationale: Factory documents delegating tasks in plain language via chat/CLI/App and reviewing diffs (factory-docs-1, factory-docs-5), and Missions for planning multi-feature work with 'structured orchestration' (factory-docs-11, factory-docs-14), which supports turning a described feature/bug into a scoped task. However, there is no detailed documentation of an explicit intent-to-spec pipeline (e.g., generating acceptance criteria, formal task scoping artifacts, or a distinct 'task planning' output before implementation) — missing for 10: explicit spec/task-scoping artifact generation, evidence of acceptance-criteria extraction, and independent hands-on confirmation that plain-language bug/feature descriptions reliably produce well-scoped tasks.
